title: Privacy-preserving inference on hosted models: a learned input-embedding transform for frozen Qwen3.8-27B
abstract: arXiv:2610.27817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every prompt sent to a hosted language model is readable by whoever runs it. We study whether the prompt can remain on the client while the host receives transformed vectors that stand in for it. A language model converts text to vectors exactly once, with a public lookup table; we perform that step locally and pass the vectors through a small trained network (55.6M parameters) before they leave the perimeter. The host runs a frozen 27B model (Qwen3.8-27B) on the transformed vectors and never receives text or token ids. We train the transform against the frozen model as a fixed judge, combining a forward-KL utility term with an auxiliary term that pushes each vector away from its original direction. On 1,490 MMLU questions held out from training, the transform costs 1.5 points of accuracy (80.7% vs. 82.3%), breaking 68 of the 1,226 questions the unmodified model answers correctly (5.5%), while 30.1% of content tokens no longer decode to

translated_title: 面向托管模型的隐私保护推理：一种用于冻结Qwen3.8-27B的可学习输入嵌入变换
translated_abstract: 发送给托管语言模型的每一个提示（prompt）都能被运行该模型的一方读取。我们研究提示能否保留在客户端，而让主机接收代替它的变换后向量。语言模型通过公开的查找表将文本转换为向量，且该步骤只发生一次；我们在本地执行这一步，并在向量离开安全边界之前，将其通过一个参数量仅5560万（55.6M）的小型训练网络。主机在变换后的向量上运行冻结的270亿参数模型（Qwen3.8-27B），从不接收文本或token id。我们以冻结模型作为固定的评判者来训练该变换，将前向KL效用项与一个将每个向量推离其原始方向的辅助项相结合。在从训练集中留出的1,490个MMLU问题上，该变换仅造成1.5个百分点的准确率损失（80.7% 对 82.3%），使未修改模型答对的1,226个问题中有68个（5.5%）不再能正确回答，同时30.1%的内容token不再能解码为
tldr: 该论文提出在客户端本地完成文本到嵌入向量的转换，并经一个55.6M参数的小型可训练网络变换后再交给托管端冻结的Qwen3.8-27B推理，使主机完全接触不到文本和token id，仅以1.5个百分点的MMLU准确率损失（80.7% vs 82.3%）实现了对托管模型的隐私保护推理。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a learned 55.6M-parameter input-embedding transform applied locally on the client, so that a hosted frozen Qwen3.8-27B never receives text or token ids, achieving privacy-preserving inference on hosted models at a cost of only 1.5 points of MMLU accuracy (80.7% vs. 82.3%).
